question: Which of the following countries are covered by the Amazon rain forest?

options.text: South Africa, Zambia, Zimbabwe and South Sudan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil, Colombia, Venezuela and Bolivia**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Amazon is a vast biome that spans eight rapidly developing countries:**

 
 
• **Brazil**,
 
• **Bolivia**,
 
• Peru,
 
• Ecuador,
 
• **Colombia**,
 
• **Venezuela**,
 
• Guyana, and
 
• Suriname and
 
• French Guiana, an overseas territory of France.
 
 
 
• **Hence Option 1 is the correct answer.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• As an ecosystem, Amazon is one of the most biodiverse places on earth. Over 3 million species live in the rainforest, and over 2,500 tree species help to create and sustain this vibrant ecosystem.
 
• The major part of the "Amazon forest" is contained in Brazil (60%), Peru (13%), and Colombia (10%).
 
• The Amazon rainforest is the largest "Tropical Rainforest" and the largest "Biodiverse Field" in the world. 
 
• The Amazon Basin is roughly the size of the forty-eight contiguous United States and covers some 40 per cent of the South American continent.
